note: Verified-extras: nodes proven in PIE-verified templates/R-rules but MISSING from node_dictionary_merged.json (main dict covers only library static functions, not Actor/Component members or special K2Nodes). Entries marked pattern: are type_id construction rules, not fixed ids. Searched by scripts/search_node_dict.ps1 alongside the main dict. NAMESPACE CAVEAT (live-verified 2026-09-06): the MAIN dictionary stores palette display names (e.g. 'float * float', category 'Flow Control', 'To String (Integer)') which are NOT usable tool type_ids - tool ids use compact forms (Utilities|Operators|Multiply, Utilities|FlowControl|Branch, Utilities|String|ToString(Integer)). Entries below carry tool-verified ids only.

Game|SpawnActorfromClass.notes: Class pin wants generated class path WITH _C suffix (R7). 'bind' takes the return pin. CollisionHandlingOverride values quoted: "AlwaysSpawn" (R5).

Actor|GetComponentbyClass.notes: ComponentClass takes quoted /Script path, e.g. "/Script/Engine.StaticMeshComponent". Core of the runtime physics activation chain (R23).

Physics|SetSimulatePhysics.notes: self pin takes the COMPONENT ref (feed from GetComponentbyClass return). Runtime activation at BeginPlay is 100% reliable in PIE; editor-time property setting is NOT (R23).

Game|Player|IsInputKeyDown.notes: self pin = PlayerController, NOT the actor (R6): bind GetPlayerController first. Key values quoted: "W" "S" "A" "D" "SpaceBar". Bool cannot enter operators - convert via (select b 1.0 0.0) (R4).

Input|EnableInput.notes: Non-Pawn actors ignore keyboard until this runs in BeginPlay with GetPlayerController (P9).

Transformation|AddActorWorldOffset.notes: bSweep=true only collides via the ROOT component (R9/G4) - promote mesh to root first.

Transformation|GetActorLocation.notes: Read ANOTHER actor's location by feeding it to self: (Transformation|GetActorLocation :self OtherActor) - pattern used in scene_watcher.txt.

Transformation|SetActorRotation.notes: Feeds from RInterpTo return (a Rotator, R17) - wrap raw floats with MakeRotator first.

Transformation|GetDistanceTo.notes: Proximity trigger pattern (G5/#52): flying DefaultPawn cannot push physics bodies - trigger on distance < ~250 instead.

Actor|ActorHasTag.notes: Gate overlap arming by tag or the PLAYER becomes the target (#51).

UserInterface|CreateWidget.notes: Class pin (NOT WidgetClass) takes the WBP _C path (R16/#30); OwningPlayer from GetPlayerController.

UserInterface|Viewport|AddtoViewport.notes: Exact casing 'AddtoViewport' (lowercase 'to') - NOT 'AddToViewport'. Category path is UserInterface|Viewport (R16).

Utilities|Casting|CastTo<BPNameWithUnder.notes: UNDERSCORES KEPT in the node name: CastToBP_Inventory (OPPOSITE of the cross-BP call rule R12 which strips them - stripped CastToBPInventory FAILS 'does not exist', verified English locale 2026-09-06; engine-class casts are CastToObject etc). LOCALE WARNING: the cast category may localize in Chinese editors (palette shows 工具|Casting|...) while function nodes (Actor|, Game|...) keep untranslated metadata categories - in zh editors prefer the GAOC typed-output pattern to avoid Cast entirely. Object pin MUST have a typed non-empty source or compile fails 'undetermined' (#42). Exec outs: then / CastFailed.
Utilities|Casting|CastTo<BPNameWithUnder.source: [VERIFIED 2026-09-06 UE5.8-EN] create_node CastToBP_Inventory success + pins readback; stripped-form failure confirmed same session

Actor|GetAllActorsOfClass.notes: TYPED-OUTPUT GENERIC: OutActors type FOLLOWS the ActorClass pin - GAOC(:ActorClass="/Game/.../BP_X.BP_X_C") outputs a BP_X_C array, so foreach elements can feed cross-BP calls DIRECTLY with NO Cast node (verified PIE 2026-09-06: foreach elem -> Class|BPX|Func :self elem, printed 42 per instance). This AVOIDS the whole failure-prone Cast family (locale-sensitive category + inverted underscore rule). Sibling: Actor|GetAllActorsOfClasswithTag. Loop-body calls are safe (unlike pure nodes - G6 hoisting applies to pure nodes only).
Actor|GetAllActorsOfClass.source: [VERIFIED 2026-09-06 UE5.8-EN] PIE end-to-end, CCC test bed

Class|<BPNameNoUnderscores>|<Member>.notes: Strip underscores from BP name: BP_GridGameMode -> Class|BPGridGameMode|GetTheDoor (R12/#29/#40). Same-BP calls use (BP_C|Func).

AddEvent|<Path>.notes: EventTick/EventBeginPlay work BARE in (event ...) for ACTOR BPs. Collision events need full path: AddEvent|Collision|EventActorBeginOverlap, AddEvent|Collision|EventHit (R1). WIDGET (UserWidget) events need the UserInterface segment: AddEvent|UserInterface|EventTick / EventConstruct / EventPreConstruct / EventDestruct / EventOnInitialized - bare EventTick FAILS in WBP graphs. Multi-param events list ALL params in ONE parenthesized form: (event AddEvent|UserInterface|EventTick (MyGeometry InDeltaTime) ...). Keyboard/mouse CANNOT be created via DSL - create_node 'Input|KeyboardEvents|<Key>' + Python wiring (R2/#12). Overlap events deliver (OtherActor) param.
AddEvent|<Path>.source: [VERIFIED 2026-08-22 UE5.8-EN] dsl_syntax.md R1/R2 + all PIE templates; WBP paths [VERIFIED 2026-09-06 UE5.8-EN] live probes in CCC

Utilities|Operators|<Op>.notes: Tool ids [live-probed 2026-09-06]: Add / Subtract / Multiply / Divide / Equal(==) / NotEqual(!=) / Less(<) / LessEqual(<=) / Greater(>) / GreaterEqual(>=). DSL sugar (+ a b) (* a b) preferred, binary only (R3), bool NOT accepted (R4). The MAIN dictionary lists these as display names ('float * float', category Math|Float) - display forms are NOT usable type_ids.

Utilities|FlowControl|<Node>.notes: Tool ids [live-probed 2026-09-06]: Branch / Sequence / ForLoop / ForLoopwithBreak / WhileLoop / Delay / RetriggerableDelay / DelayUntilNextTick / DelayUntilNextFrame / DoOnce / DoOnceMultiInput / DoN / FlipFlop / Gate / MultiGate / Switch|SwitchonInt / SwitchonName / SwitchonString (lowercase 'on' in Switchon*). DSL sugar (if/for/while/switch) preferred. MAIN dictionary display category 'Flow Control' (WITH space) is palette-only - NOT a usable id.

Utilities|String|ToString(Integer).notes: Compact spelling (NO space) is the real tool id - create_node verified 2026-09-06. Dictionary display form 'To String (Integer)' FAILS. Short path 'Utilities|ToString(Integer)' (missing String segment) FAILS. Siblings: ToString(Boolean):InBool, ToString(Float):InFloat, ToString(Object), ToString(Name), ToString(Vector), ToString(Rotator), ToString(Transform).
